act_title: Investigate the Fatui Camps Marked by Sosi

quests.title: Investigate the Fatui Camps Marked by Sosi

dialogue.t: Hey, you scheming humans! I suggest leaving this place at once — the heritage and secrets of us Pari are not for you to covet, and certainly not within your reach.
...Pari? You're a Pari! Oh, what an amazing experience!
Oh! And there's also a wiry young man(little young lady) with his(her)... pet?
Hey, watch what you say! Paimon's his(her) best friend!
Friend... Why, of course! "Best friend"... What a beautiful sound! I've always wanted to have a "best friend" since childhood...
Wiry young man(Little young lady), you're certainly not in need of two best friends, are you?
I mean... Even if you're the one having two best friends, don't you think it's a little unfair?
Inequities like this are impossible to forgive... So please, hand the Pari over to me. As for how I'll treat it... you wouldn't have to worry. I'll make sure it's used to its full potential.
Whoa, he's being so unreasonable... There's no getting through to him!
We can always make him understand without wasting our words... My clever Yasnapati, surely you know what I mean?
Oh, Paimon knows! Sorush wants us to teach him a lesson!

quests.description: According to Sosi, some uninvited guests seem to be coveting the divine powers of the monument. You might have to defeat their officer in order to drive them away…
